verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. The pack shows only that an OpenAPI spec file exists (HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key), plus webhooks and MCP connectivity. Nothing documents API versioning, version lifecycles, or a deprecation policy, and a spec file alone does not establish either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
